name: genpark-audio-packet-jitter-resilience-buffer-skill
description: Adaptive WebRTC audio packet jitter buffer and packet loss concealment (PLC) engine maintaining smooth voice playout over volatile network streams.
author: AlphaPark

tools.name: ingest_packet
tools.description: Ingest an incoming audio packet with sequence number, payload size, and arrival timestamp.

tools.name: extract_playout_frame
tools.description: Extract the next sequential audio frame for playback with automatic PLC if missing.

tools.name: get_jitter_telemetry
tools.description: Compute RFC 3550 inter-arrival jitter variance and buffer depth health.

tools.name: run_benchmark_jitter_simulation
tools.description: Simulate out-of-order and dropped audio packets to verify resilience.
